mapper.select: SELECT Count(*) FROM Dept WHERE DEL_STATUS = 0

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ROWNUM rn, a.* FROM ( SELECT DEPT_CODE , DEPT_NAME , DEPT_CAPTAIN , PARENT_DEPT_CODE , DEPT_LOC , LOC_DETAIL , DEL_STATUS , REGISTRAR , IN_DATE FROM DEPT WHERE DEL_STATUS = 0
ORDER BY DEPT_CODE ASC ) a ) WHERE rn BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end}

SELECT d.DEPT_CODE , d.DEPT_NAME , d.DEPT_CAPTAIN , d.PARENT_DEPT_CODE , d.DEPT_LOC , d.LOC_DETAIL , d.DEL_STATUS , d.REGISTRAR , r.EMP_NAME as REGISTRAR_NAME , c.EMP_NAME as DEPT_CAPTAIN_NAME , p.DEPT_NAME as PARENT_DEPT_NAME , d.IN_DATE FROM DEPT d LEFT JOIN EMP r ON r.EMP_NO = d.REGISTRAR LEFT JOIN EMP c ON c.EMP_NO = d.DEPT_CAPTAIN LEFT JOIN DEPT p ON p.Dept_Code = d.PARENT_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.DEPT_CODE = #{deptCode} AND d.DEL_STATUS = 0 ORDER BY DEPT_CODE ASC

SELECT e.EMP_NO AS empNo, e.EMP_NAME AS empName, d.DEPT_NAME AS deptName, e.EMAIL AS email FROM EMP e LEFT JOIN DEPT d ON d.DEPT_CODE = e.DEPT_CODE WHERE e.DEL_STATUS = 0 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM DEPT dx WHERE dx.DEPT_CAPTAIN = e.EMP_NO AND dx.DEL_STATUS = 0 AND TO_CHAR(dx.DEPT_CAPTAIN) NOT LIKE '9%' ) AND UPPER(e.EMP_NAME) LIKE NVL('%' || UPPER(TRIM(#{keyword})) || '%', '%') ORDER BY e.EMP_NAME
SELECT d.*, e.emp_name AS deptCaptainName FROM DEPT d LEFT JOIN EMP e ON e.emp_no = d.dept_captain WHERE d.dept_code = #{deptCode}
SELECT DEPT_CODE, DEPT_NAME, PARENT_DEPT_CODE FROM DEPT WHERE DEL_STATUS = 0 AND PARENT_DEPT_CODE IS NULL AND DEPT_NAME LIKE '%' || #{deptName} || '%'
SELECT dept_code deptCode, dept_name deptName FROM DEPT WHERE DEL_STATUS = 0 AND DEPT_NAME LIKE '%' || #{deptName} || '%'
